name: interlace-ui
title: Interlace Design System
description: A 144-item shadcn-protocol registry of React components that publish their own contract: RSC boundary, minimum viewport, keyboard path, state union and semver.

skills.name: discover-interlace-components
skills.description: Find a component in the Interlace design system by what it must DO — server-safe, keyboard-operable, has a loading state, models an absence — rather than by name. Use before writing any UI against this registry.

skills.name: install-interlace-component
skills.description: Install a component from the Interlace registry into a project with the shadcn CLI, including the CSS baseline it assumes and the dependency graph the CLI walks. Use when a component has been chosen and needs to land in a repo.

skills.name: read-interlace-contract
skills.description: Read one Interlace component’s full contract — props, state union, keyboard path, ARIA, minimum viewport, version history — before generating code against it. Use whenever an item has been picked but its API is not yet known.

capabilities: discover items by contract (rendering boundary, minViewport, keyboard, state union, loading state)
read one item’s full contract, props and source before generating code
install an item with the shadcn CLI, including its transitive registry dependencies
